digest: Coverage centred on Max Verstappen converting pole into his 75th grand prix win, joking that he last won such a race on Mario Kart (Motorsport.com). Lando Norris recovered from outside the points to second while watching his battery, and Toto Wolff was thrilled by the spectacle despite both Mercedes drivers slipping off the podium late on (Motorsport.com). Autosport asked whether the race was the year's best or too fake. Other themes included another Hamilton-Leclerc clash, a Russell-Verstappen war of words, Hadjar's 15th place (Motorsport.com) and Verstappen's possible Daytona 24 Hours entry.
